text:
jeff (support): heads up — customers seeing 503/500 from hosted inference in eu-west-1 since ~11:02 UTC. spike in upstream runner restarts, multiple tickets opened. dashboard: https://console.redwood/ops/regions/eu-west-1/errors :eyes:
incident-bot: Alert: region=eu-west-1 metric=5xx_rate threshold=5% window=5m
sam (oncall): oncall here, I'm pulling logs and core dumps. which pools affected? runner ids?
maria (eng-sre): i have snippets — looks like GPU OOM followed immediately by segfault and container restart on the upstream inference process. excerpt below:
```
[2026-03-18T11:02:12Z] runner[pid=3421]: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory while allocating 2.1GiB
[2026-03-18T11:02:12Z] runner[pid=3421]: killing process due to OOM
[2026-03-18T11:02:12Z] kernel: trap in unexpected state: SIGSEGV (11) at 0x7f8c3a1b2f
[2026-03-18T11:02:12Z] backtrace:
  0x7f8c3a1b2f in aten::native::conv2d
  0x55aa12b4f in runtime::invoke_model
  0x55aa12c01 in upstream::worker_loop
```
maria (eng-sre): stack shows model hot-swap path triggered while worker was mid-prefetch. repro consistent in staging when combining: large context + model swap + batch_size=8
jeff (support): impact scope? which customers hit hard? are auth failures involved?
anya (cs): confirmed impact for two enterprise accounts (acme-co, helixfinance). both reported streaming timeouts and 503 spikes for ~12-18m. acme escalated to priority; billing asked for credits. no auth errors in their traces, pure 5xx from gateway.
sam (oncall): collecting node metadata: affected nodes in pool euw-ml-optimized-{a,b}; GPU type A100-40. kernel logs show repeated cuda OOM then segfaults in same seconds. attaching hostd logs to the ticket.
maria (eng-sre): quick mitigation plan applied: 1) disable prefetch for model hot-swap path (runtime flag) 2) set soft OOM threshold from 0.8 -> 0.92 for the pool 3) enable fallback routing for tier=hosted-low to cpu-fallback for in-flight requests 4) rollback latest quantized runtime commit (suspected memory regression)
deploy-bot: rollback quant-runtime@7f3a2 deployed to eu-west-1 at 2026-03-18T11:22:04Z by sam (oncall) :white_check_mark:
sam (oncall): after rollback + prefetch disable p95 latency down from 1.8s -> 300ms and 5xx rate back to baseline. continuing watch.
jeff (support): CS notified customers, issued interim credits to acme-co and helixfinance (30% of affected window) and scheduled follow-up calls.
anya (cs): customers acknowledged credits, asked for RCA and timeline for permanent fix.
maria (eng-sre): followups (todo): 1) collect full coredumps and run addr2line on backtraces 2) reproduce locally with harness: large-context + simultaneous model swap + batch_resize 3) add guardrail: reject model-swap requests when running context>p95 or qps>threshold 4) add autoscaler rule to preemptively provision +20% capacity when model_swap events spike
sam (oncall): quick repro steps i used in staging (do not run against prod):
```
# create high QPS client, stream multi-chunk prompts
for i in $(seq 1 100); do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \
    -d '{"model":"redwood/rlhf-quant","input":"long prompt ...","batch_size":8}' \
    https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate &
done
# trigger model swap on pool while load is active
# monitor /var/log/runner.log for OOM then SIGSEGV
```
maria (eng-sre): i've opened ENG-5912 with attached dumps and staging repro notes. marking triage complete for now. will keep thread updated with root cause.
jeff (support): thanks all — CS will keep customers in loop and schedule RCA call. closing incident once postmortem posted. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated region=eu-west-1 started=2026-03-18T11:02:00Z mitigated=2026-03-18T11:24:00Z
sam (oncall): monitoring window 1h — will reopen if we see recurrence.
maria (eng-sre): preliminary suspicion: quant-runtime memory regression + prefetch path race during hot model swap. next steps: deeper memory profiling and hot-swap crash guard.
anya (cs): will attach customer quotes and escalate to account team for permanent SLA discussion.
jeff (support): thread summary: root cause suspected GPU memory regression in quantized runtime triggered by concurrent hot-swap + high-batch load -> OOM -> segfault -> container restart -> 5xx cascade. mitigations: rollback, disable prefetch, raise soft-oom threshold, fallback routing, credits issued. followups assigned to ENG-5912.
